# Feedlens.ai

> Discover and copy the prompts behind AI-generated images. Feedlens.ai is a discovery platform that pairs AI content from Twitter/X, Instagram, Reddit, YouTube, and TikTok with the prompts that produced it.

Feedlens.ai curates AI images created with the models actually present on the platform — currently GPT Image, GPT Image 2, Midjourney v8.1, Nano Banana 2, and Nano Banana Pro. For each post, the prompt sits next to the image (in JSON when relevant), copyable in one click, organizable into folders, and ready to use as a remix reference.

Audience: AI artists, prompt engineers, content creators, and designers doing visual research.

## Public pages
- [Discover feed](https://feedlens.ai/): Main stream of the freshest and trending AI prompts. Filterable by model and platform.
- [Trending prompts](https://feedlens.ai/?sort=top): The most-liked prompts.
- [Filter by model](https://feedlens.ai/?model=midjourney): Feed filtered to a specific AI model (`?model=<slug>`).
- [Filter by platform](https://feedlens.ai/?platform=x): Feed filtered to a specific source platform (`?platform=<slug>`).

## Data structure
Every prompt includes:
- Image (single, multi-image carousel, or remix input/output)
- Prompt text (plain text or JSON)
- Generation model (e.g. Midjourney v8.1, Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2)
- Original source platform and creator handle
- Source URL (link to the original post)
- Posted timestamp, like and save counts
- Prompt type: standard or remix (image-to-image)

## Access and limits
- The home feed and filter combinations are indexable.
- Individual prompt detail pages (`/prompt/<id>`) are marked `noindex`; they don't show up in search results, but OpenGraph previews work when shared.
- User profiles, saved-folder views (`/?view=saved`), the admin panel, and auth pages are not crawled (`robots.txt` `disallow`).
- API endpoints (`/api/posts`, `/api/saved`, `/api/report`) are rate-limited; automated scraping is discouraged.
